events.summary: The Sea of Laments comes into being during the Thaw as meltwater from four glaciers rushes out, flooding Terisiare.
events.quote: The Sea of Laments came into being during the Thaw

events.summary: Wizards and sages of the School of the Unseen help evacuate and resettle flood victims.
events.quote: they helped evacuate, rescue, and resettle those whose homes and towns were lost to the floods
